Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies L.P. and Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies (TE) L.P. reported Thursday they have raised a combined $412.5 million through recent unregistered sales of limited partnership units, according to a statement released in a SEC filing.

On October 1, Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies L.P. sold units for approximately $315.7 million, while the feeder fund, Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies (TE) L.P., raised $96.7 million. The issuances were made in private offerings to accredited investors and qualified purchasers, exempt from registration under U.S. securities laws. The number of units sold by each fund was finalized Thursday following the calculation of transactional net asset values as of September 30.

The funds also announced the redesignation and creation of new series of limited partnership units, including new series within Class I, Class S, and Class D units. These changes were reflected in amendments to the funds’ partnership agreements and investment management agreements, executed Thursday.

As of September 30, the transactional net asset value (NAV) per unit for Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies L.P. ranged from $30.93 to $31.42 across various classes, while for the feeder fund, values ranged from $30.45 to $31.77. The aggregate transactional NAV for Blackstone Infrastructure Strategies was approximately $6.7 billion, and the broader Blackstone Infrastructure Fund Program stood at about $7.4 billion.

The funds declared regular distributions for each class of units, with gross distribution amounts per unit ranging from $0.2266 to $0.2289. These distributions are payable to unitholders of record as of September 30 and are expected to be paid on or about November 3, either in cash or through reinvestment.

The information in this article is based on a press release statement filed with the SEC. The funds do not have securities listed on a public exchange and therefore do not have a stock ticker.
